description: This source file defines the MonkeyCommandEvent class, which extends MonkeyEvent and represents an event that executes a shell command within the Android 'monkey' testing framework. It provides a method to inject the event by executing the command and handling possible exceptions.

classes.name: MonkeyCommandEvent
classes.description: Represents a shell command event in the Android Monkey testing framework, capable of executing a command when injected.

methods.name: MonkeyCommandEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a shell command string.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Executes the stored shell command by spawning a process and waits for its completion; logs the result or any exceptions encountered.
